notes.title: October Update!
notes.content:
[h1]This is a biggie[/h1]
[h3]1. Redid song detection system, songs are preprocessed and enemies are spawned before song
2. Redid entire pattern spawning systems, much more customizable and dynamic
3. Added separate music and SFX sliders
4. More options [including fancier trails and other graphics settings]
5. Several FPS improvements[/h3]
